name: PDS P-003: the rig preflight runs before the first rig ssh, refuses a violated check by name before any phase, and completes in seconds on the real physical rig (live, 2026-09-30)
summary: On the real physical rig (tower + VM aviweiss@172.31.44.2) `physical-drill-producer rig-preflight` measured all five checks (drill-source-committed, canary-mode-baseline, vm-trust-hold-ready, vm-payload-current, hosts-answering), all ok, in elapsedMs=2023 (7.96 s wall including tsx start) at 09:06:34Z. A real drill run at 02:03Z with uncommitted pot-git drill source was refused by the probe's rig preflight before any phase: PHYSICAL_PREFLIGHT_FAILED drill-source-committed, naming the two files, 19 s after the harness started, with an empty physical-probe.stdout (no phase ran).

assertions.criteria: On the real rig the preflight measures its five checks and completes in under a minute.
assertions.observed: Report schemaVersion hive-git-physical-rig-preflight/v1, checks=[drill-source-committed, canary-mode-baseline, vm-trust-hold-ready, vm-payload-current, hosts-answering], ok=true, firstFailure=null, elapsedMs=2023; process wall 7960 ms (09:06:34.597Z-09:06:42.559Z).
assertions.evidence: command: PAPERCUSP_REPO_DIR=<repo> PCUSP_VM_SSH=aviweiss@172.31.44.2 tsx packages/operator-core/lib/sync/pot-git/physical-drill-producer.ts rig-preflight --vm-github-user-id 1567022 (the exact call hive-git-physical-probe.sh line 369 makes, run standalone); .papercusp/scratch/pds-r5-live-preflight.json

assertions.criteria: A violated check refuses the run before the first phase and names the check.
assertions.observed: Run 20260930T020304Z-3605465 (verification-harness start 02:03:04.978Z): stderr 'PHYSICAL_PREFLIGHT_FAILED drill-source-committed: uncommitted drill source (the VM stages HEAD via git archive, so it would run different code): packages/operator-core/lib/sync/pot-git/physical-drill-phase-d.ts, packages/operator-core/lib/sync/pot-git/physical-drill-phase-e.ts' then 'hive-git-physical-probe: rig preflight refused the run (the PHYSICAL_PREFLIGHT_FAILED line above names the check)'. Evidence dir stamped 02:03:24Z (rc1); physical-probe.stdout is empty and no PHASE_START line exists. Harness result verdict=fail.

assertions.criteria: The probe runs rig-preflight before its first rig ssh and fails closed.
assertions.observed: hive-git-physical-probe.sh calls `$TSX $PRODUCER rig-preflight` (line 369) and `fail`s on a non-zero exit (line 372) before `run_dir` is created (line 374) and before any phase's rig ssh; the rc1 run above shows the fail-closed path on the real rig. Unit guard: physical-drill-preflight.test.ts (33/33, test run 20227298).

falsifier: A physical run reaches its first rig ssh without rig-preflight having run; a violation of any of the five checks lets the run start; a refusal does not name the check; an unmeasured check passes; or the preflight takes a minute or more.
command: bash papercusp-desktop/bin/hive-git-drill.sh --only-phase <X> (run 20260930T020304Z-3605465, refused by the rig preflight)
note: The standalone preflight is read-only (no rig mutation). It ran unpinned, so drill-source-committed checked that the live pot-git drill source was committed (git status --porcelain was empty at 09:06Z).
